facts.text: Belize faces the Caribbean Sea rather than the Pacific.
English is the country’s official language.
Maya archaeological sites and coral reefs are among its landmarks.

culture.text: Garifuna, Maya, Creole, and other communities contribute to Belize’s varied cultural life.

food.name: Rice and beans
food.text: This Belizean staple combines rice and beans, commonly flavored with coconut milk.
